name: Chrome Bridge (PoC)
description: Drive your own Chrome from Speedwave: open windows and tabs, read pages, click, type, take screenshots and run JavaScript through a companion Chrome extension
instructions:
## Connecting Chrome

The tools talk to a companion extension in your Chrome. Use a separate Chrome profile without bank or client accounts: the extension can read and control every tab.

**One-time install:**

1. Speedwave unpacks this plugin to `~/.speedwave/plugins/chrome/` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.speedwave\plugins\chrome\`). The extension is in the `extension/` subfolder.
2. In Chrome open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked** and pick the `extension/` folder.
3. On this page, copy URL and Token from the **Bridge connection** card.
4. Click the Speedwave icon in the Chrome toolbar, paste both and click **Connect**.

**Each session:** Speedwave Desktop must be running; the extension reconnects on its own.
